'''Varacen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], he could be found at the [[Wilds Laboratory]] where he was collecting [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]] [[Bone/Legends|bone]] marrow.
